title: An etale-smooth local property on the source and target is checked on one presentation of a DM morphism
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives the etale-smooth analogue of the standard localness criterion: for a DM morphism of algebraic stacks a property of morphisms of algebraic spaces which is etale-smooth local on the source-and-target may be checked on a single presentation, with the same variants for representable morphisms (author lemma at source lines 7764-7793, label lemma-etale-smooth-local-source-target). The proof (source lines 7795-7916) uses the DM hypothesis to produce the presentation, then proves the converse through a comparison diagram in which the extra etale condition on the diagrams makes the relevant vertical arrows etale, and transports the property along the smooth localness on the target and the etale localness on the source before applying the third clause of the definition (proof lines 7851-7880); the representable cases are reduced to the characterisation for algebraic spaces and to a base change diagram with a scheme (proof lines 7882-7915). The etale bookkeeping in the comparison diagram is the content. H3.
